referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official House Doctor Painting Bay Area homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a darkened exterior-home photograph supports a large white editorial service promise and two short contact controls. It uses very thin dark utility strip over an airy white service-navigation row. The visual system relies on confident editorial serif headings with restrained sans labels and body; surfaces include white, near-black, warm off-white and accents include signal red, soft gray. Imagery is real painted homes, rooms, workplaces, and a process video poster. The page then runs through exterior-home hero, red proof strip, four painting service cards, dark preparation chapter, customer proof, property-type feature, project gallery, video proof, service areas and FAQ, red estimate close. Its service presentation is four image cards covering interior, exterior, commercial, and deck or fence projects. Mobile changes to stack service cards and project samples, retain the red estimate action, and keep preparation steps in a clear order. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy House Doctor identity, project photographs, license number, guarantee, customer quotations, staff, or exact typography.
